content.introduction: According to TechNewsWorld, there are updates on AI, robotics, virtual reality, and home tech, including news on smoke detection and malware threats. TechCrunch reports on Google freezing its open source bug bounty program due to a rise in AI submissions, a federal judge calling Flock 'indiscriminate mass surveillance,' and Apple tightening macOS 'Full Disk Access' controls due to new risks from AI agents. Google News highlights Casio's release of a limited-edition sapphire G-Shock MRG-D5000 and Amazon's clearance on AirPods Pro 3. The sources don't provide a definitive answer to specific questions not directly addressed.
